dataset: AgeDB photo release, team-generated AgeDB-30-style pairs (seed 0); not the official AgeDB-30 protocol
note: Paired identity-level bootstrap. A CI excluding 0 supports a difference on these pairs only.
dataset_limitation: Dataset limitation: potential identity-label inconsistencies were identified in 5 names (both genders appear in their file names), including one that may combine two individuals. 2.9% of same-person pairs involve these names; this is a count of potentially affected pairs, not a verified number of mislabelled pairs. The impact on evaluation metrics and on the comparison between configurations has not been quantified.
